mechanism_narrative: Sustained upward trend in RETAIL_REC (rising from -17.4% to -8.9% over 4 weeks) indicates recovery momentum that will continue linearly over the next 4 weeks, producing net positive direction relative to the baseline period.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 8.5 percentage points over 4 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days falls below -8.9% or declines week-on-week in 3 of 4 weeks ahead.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GROCERY_PHARM visits (5.6% to 9.9%) signal increased essential-trip frequency that generates spillover retail browsing behavior, driving RETAIL_REC upward as consumers combine trips over the next 2 weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM sustains above 9% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM at +9.9% in most recent week
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 5% in either of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to current -8.9% level.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility remains depressed (-6.6%) but is recovering faster than RETAIL_REC. When WORKPLACES recovery accelerates past -5%, it will trigger commute-linked retail visits within 1 week, lifting RETAIL_REC directionally positive.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -5% in any single week
failure_condition: WORKPLACES does not exceed -5% within 4 weeks, or RETAIL_REC fails to show week-on-week improvement in the week following WORKPLACES crossing -5%.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility exhibits high volatility (40.3% to 12.7% to 50.3%) indicating weather-driven or event-driven outdoor activity swings. When PARKS exceeds 40%, it crowds out RETAIL_REC as consumers substitute outdoor for indoor recreation, suppressing retail mobility over the next 4 weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS sustains above 40% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases relative to current -8.9% level despite PARKS remaining above 40%, or PARKS falls below 30% within 2 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction of weak TRANSIT (-13.4%) and recovering WORKPLACES (-6.6%) creates a regime where commuters shift to private transport. This reduces transit-node retail exposure but increases car-based retail destination visits, producing net positive RETAIL_REC over 4 weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -15% while WORKPLACES improves above -10%
failure_condition: TRANSIT recovers above -10% before WORKPLACES reaches -5%, or RETAIL_REC declines relative to -8.9% baseline.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility near zero (0.7%) combined with RETAIL_REC still negative (-8.9%) indicates ongoing mobility restrictions or behavioral caution. If RESIDENTIAL rises above 2% (signaling restriction relaxation), RETAIL_REC will follow upward within 2 weeks as confidence returns.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 2% in any week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declining from 4.4% to 0.7% over 4 weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL does not exceed 2% within 4 weeks, or RETAIL_REC remains below -5% despite RESIDENTIAL crossing 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction of PARKS surge (50.3%) and RESIDENTIAL collapse (0.7%) indicates May school holidays or seasonal event driving outdoor activity and away-from-home behavior. This suppresses RETAIL_REC over the next 4 weeks as foot traffic diverts to parks and outdoor venues.
candidate_trigger: PARKS exceeds 45% AND RESIDENTIAL falls below 2% simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at +50.3% and RESIDENTIAL at +0.7% in current week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases relative to -8.9% despite PARKS-RESIDENTIAL condition holding, or PARKS falls below 30% within 2 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM recovery (5.6% to 9.9%) combined with TRANSIT weakness (-13.4%) indicates consumers are making essential trips via private transport but not extending to discretionary retail. RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed or decline further over 4 weeks unless TRANSIT recovers above -10%.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above 8% while TRANSIT remains below -12%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases relative to -8.9% despite GROCERY_PHARM-TRANSIT condition holding, or TRANSIT recovers above -10% within 2 weeks.
